clusters.title: Triton `kernel_load_start_hook` AttributeError → fleet-wide AMD scheduler crash (server exit -9)

details.label: Status
details.text: NEW today, **already resolved**. First fail Aug-06 00:24; reverted Aug-06 06:36. Hit every server-launching AMD test in run [31059578786](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/31059578786) (~30 shards, all `setUpClass`).

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` [#33120](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33120) ([`a3a1ebc7b`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/a3a1ebc7b7ee7ab185213b1a58ad6e482b7e15b1), merged Aug-05 21:55) added `triton_load_watch.install()` at `scheduler.py:1646`, which calls `knobs.runtime.kernel_load_start_hook.add()` unguarded; the `try/except` only catches `ImportError`, not `AttributeError`. AMD image ships Triton 3.4.0 (no such hook). **Disconfirming**: (none — crash line, introducing commit, and pass→fail boundary all agree).

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ✅ revert [#33826](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33826) MERGED Aug-06 06:36. ⚠️ **reland [#33908](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33908) OPEN** — must add `hasattr`/version guard on `triton_load_watch.py:50` before merge. Guard-only PR [#33792](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33792) was closed unmerged. **Suggested triage**: gate [#33908](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33908) on `hasattr(knobs.runtime,"kernel_load_start_hook")` and re-run `test_basic_sanity.py` on MI300 Triton 3.4.
